page.layout: One printed page, title page. Decorative type band at the top; centred title block of lines in mixed roman, capitals, small capitals and italic; decorative band at the foot. No notes, no running head, no page number.
page.notes: Printing as seen: "THESE S" has a space before the final s, printed that way. Decorative bands above and below the title block are ornaments, not text, and are not transcribed. The "&" in the italic line is the printed Et-ligature. The "XIII." is followed by a small printed mark, not transcribed. The "eximiè" accent is read as grave; certain enough, no [?] added.
